deploy-bot: deploy complete: kv-cache-service v2.4.0 -> prod-us-east. postdeploy synths started against 10% canary. run id 20260320-01. https://deploys.redwood/release/20260320-01
slee: seeing uptick in synth probe 'stale-kv' errors on canary hosts — ~12% failing in last 2m. logs show 'kv cache returned STALE for key synth:probe:...'
mpatel: what's the intended cache invalidation behavior for this rollout? do we expect an active flush?
jgreen: we relied on versioned keys rather than a sweep flush for this change. looks like a reader/writer TTL mismatch might be exposing stale entries during transition.
slee: sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T15:12:34Z] ERROR synth-probe id=20260320-01-7 kv_cache.get(key=synth:probe:abc) -> STALE_RESPONSE ttl=0.2s expected>=1.0s
```
sre-oncall: @slee @mpatel what's blast radius? canary is small but if probes are upstreaming alerts we should act fast. if this persists and affecting >20% we should roll back.
mpatel: canary is only 10% but alerts are noisy. prefer non-rollback first: flush synth- keys on canary nodes and rerun probes. if that doesn't fix within 10m, rollback to v2.3.9 per rollback runbook.
jgreen: agreed. preparing admin flush command. please stand by.
mpatel: curl to run against canary admin endpoint:
```
curl -X POST "https://kv-admin.prod-us-east.internal/flush?prefix=synth-" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
jgreen: running flush on canaries now...
deploy-bot: task 0x9f2b started: flush prefix=synth- on cluster prod-us-east-canary
jgreen: flush returned 200 OK for all 12 canary hosts (duration ~18s)
slee: re-running synth probes — failure rate down to ~1.8% over last 2m, tail latencies normalized.
mpatel: good — keep monitoring for 15m. if failure rate creeps above 5% revert to v2.3.9. I'll open a follow-up ticket to update release notes and the deploy checklist to include optional cache flush for this path.
sre-oncall: noted, I'll watch alerts and tag the ticket.
jgreen: closing thread for now, marking deploy healthy. :thumbsup:
